purpose: This table is a small reference lookup mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full airline name, derived from the nycflights13 airlines source restricted to the sixteen carriers that flew out of New York City in 2013; it is intended to be joined to flight fact tables on carrier_code.
usage: Join on carrier_code to enrich flight-level records with the carrier's full name; both columns are required and non-null so no null-handling logic is needed by consumers, and the grain is one row per carrier_code.
limitations: The three Airbyte capture-metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as non-business artifacts; the table has zero measured duplicate rows and zero nulls in the profiled sample, but as a static sixteen-row reference extracted at a single point in time (2026-09-02T23:26:17), it should be refreshed if new carriers begin service to NYC airports.
